summary.title: How To Build A Simple Cryptocurrency Blockchain In Node.js
summary.one_liner: You learn to build a toy blockchain called smashingCoin in Node.js using ES6 classes, SHA-256 hashing, chain validation, and a simple proof-of-work mining step.
takeaways: A block stores an index, timestamp, data, the previous block's hash, and its own hash computed with SHA-256 via crypto-js.
A blockchain is an array of blocks that starts with a hardcoded genesis block; each new block must reference the hash of the latest block.
checkChainValidity() detects tampering by recomputing each block's hash and confirming it matches the preceding block's hash.
Proof of work is simulated by incrementing a nonce until the block hash starts with a set number of zeros (difficulty set to 4 in the example).
summary.summary: The tutorial by Alfrick Opidi walks through building smashingCoin, a minimal cryptocurrency, in Node.js using JavaScript classes. It first explains core blockchain concepts such as blocks, hashing, the genesis block, consensus, and proof of work. It then implements a CryptoBlock class using the crypto-js SHA-256 module and a CryptoBlockchain class with methods to add blocks and check chain validity. The final step adds a nonce-based proof-of-work mechanism with a difficulty of four leading zeros, and the full code is provided at the end.
